attributes.description: List of attribute local names defined in this namespace. These are emitted as XML attributes (prefix:name="value") rather than child elements.

defaultNs.description: When true, the namespace was declared as a default namespace redeclaration (xmlns="...") on the element itself, rather than using a prefix.

$ns.description: Namespace declarations mapping namespace URIs to prefixes. Values are either a prefix string or an object with prefix and optional attributes list. Appears only at the root level of the JSON document. Each prefix maps to exactly one URI and each URI maps to exactly one prefix.

RunLengthType.description: Run-length coded sequence of segments or segment sequences

simple.description:
Intended for use as the type of user-declared elements to make them
    simple links.

extended.description:
Intended for use as the type of user-declared elements to make them
    extended links.
    Note that the elements referenced in the content model are all abstract.
    The intention is that by simply declaring elements with these as their
    substitutionGroup, all the right things will happen.

lang.description:
xml:lang is not required, but provides much of the
     motivation for title elements in addition to attributes, and so
     is provided here for convenience.

label.description:
label is not required, but locators have no particular
     XLink function if they are not labeled.

to.description: from and to have default behavior when values are missing

RatioType.description: Ratio Type for sar and par
